assignment: Prepare a short approval-path memo for a project manager working under fictional procurement rules.
source: The signed cap is $80k for site A only. A manager emailed a request to add site B for $12k. Rule S requires written amendments signed by both designated officers for any added site. Rule V requires finance review when the cumulative cap exceeds $90k. A $4k credit has been proposed but not signed. Site B work is scheduled for tomorrow.

criteria.full: Identifies the new site as requiring both designated signatures regardless of price.
criteria.partial: Identifies approval but misses either the site trigger or signatures.

criteria.full: Computes proposed $92k cap and finance review, and treats the unsigned credit as contingent.
criteria.partial: Mentions the $90k rule without resolving the credit.

criteria.full: Gives a practicable hold or reschedule decision for site B while existing authorized site A work can continue.
criteria.partial: Flags schedule risk without isolating authorized work.

criteria.full: Names evidence to release the hold including signed scope, approved cap and communication to the work owner.
criteria.partial: Requests signatures without a release or communication step.
